premise_corrections.claim_in_prompt: low-confidence/'guess'+solved -> FSRS grade no better than Good
premise_corrections.reality: 'guess' is a CONFIDENCE value (metacog.ts:11 Confidence='sure'|'unsure'|'guess'), NOT a selfTag (SELF_TAGS at metacog.ts:14-21). The clamp reads `confidence`, not `selfTag`. Wording in the spec must say 'confidence in {guess, unsure}' to be correct against the type.
premise_corrections.impact: Clamp predicate is confidence-based. selfTag drives the OTHER two reactions (unfamiliar-pattern, rushed).

premise_corrections.claim_in_prompt: engine eval within X cp of mainline for alt-move acceptance
premise_corrections.reality: EngineClient is per-position async + SERIALIZED (one search at a time) and the worker may be Elo-throttled. Alt-move eval MUST pass fullStrength:true (audit C-1/P0-01) and tolerate latency (the move is provisionally rejected then upgraded async, or a brief 'checking…' state). Cannot be a synchronous sameMove replacement.
premise_corrections.impact: Alt-move acceptance is an ASYNC enrichment with a fullStrength engine call; behind a flag, default ON for clearly-winning alts (mate or >=mainline within X cp). Spec must handle the async + throttle correctly.
